newsitem.title: USA: Four injured on ground in Miami plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Four injured on ground in Miami plane crash.

text.p: As many as four people on the ground were injured when a Fine Air DC-8 cargo plane crashed by a busy roadway near Miami International Airport Thursday, a firefighter said.

One of the people injured was a motorist who apparently lost control of her car when she saw the plane coming down, Metro-Dade Fire Rescue spokesman Otto Zamora said. "The call came in as a woman in shock."
Zamora described the injuries as a "mixed bag" and said the severity of the injuries was not known.
The fate of the four-person crew was also unknown, police said. Zamora said no bodies had been removed from the plane's wreckage.
